copy_policy: Only primary date/value, actual runtime metadata or clearly NVDA/Yahoo original acquisition candidates may be copied into recovered_evidence; never original path; preserve source commit/path/blob/method/SHA256/category/strength

evidence_strength_rules.MODERATE: Original yfinance output with clear legacy provenance or actual run log/parameters materially improving causal identifiability
evidence_strength_rules.STRONG: Authenticated original Yahoo payload or actual timestamped runtime acquisition/request manifest tied to legacy primary session
evidence_strength_rules.WEAK: Normalized/downstream data, implementation, reports/comments, unverified artifacts and filesystem mtime/ctime; timestamps WEAK_AUXILIARY_ONLY

failure_criteria: All seven registered search steps completed without qualifying new evidence; existing normalized/downstream/code/report/weak metadata do not count; claim limited to preserved evidence searched
immutability: All existing tracked Stage1–13.1 files and physical Git metadata/object/reflog files must retain bytes; HEAD/branch/origin/main/remote configuration remain fixed; no Git database writes or cleanup

project_search_boundaries.archive_rule: Related zip/tar archives only; inspect bounded members without extracting into original paths
project_search_boundaries.outside_repository_content_read_rule: Only explicitly nasdaq/NVDA/Yahoo/yfinance-related files, old clones or archives; unrelated project contents not read

reproducibility: At least two consecutive formal read-only seven-step runs; deterministic CSV/JSON bytes identical; audit outputs/module/tests/report excluded from search; no current execution timestamps
search_scope: Preserved reachable/deleted/reflog/unreachable Git evidence, repository-local files and limited projects evidence; only primary historical input/runtime recovery
success_criteria: At least one genuinely new legacy RAW_VENDOR_EVIDENCE, RAW_LIBRARY_EVIDENCE or RUNTIME_ACQUISITION_METADATA of STRONG or materially informative MODERATE strength, tied to the primary session and authenticated provenance
unreadable_or_skipped_rule: Record every scope candidate skipped/unreadable and any bounds explicitly; do not silently equate unreadable with absent evidence
